title: Conformal invariance at the horizon as a consequence of observability
html:
Remark. Conformal invariance at the horizon as a consequence of observability

This provides the QOU analogue to conformal invariance in Penrose's CCC [penrose2010]. In CCC, massless particles are conformally invariant; they do not see the conformal factor \Omega. Here, the degree \geq 1 jet data ignores the "size" of A_0. Only its vanishing locus matters.

The QOU observability axioms require a non-degenerate Frobenius pairing to detect degree-0 data. At the horizon, A_0 = 0 and the Frobenius pairing degenerates on that component. The surviving observations act exclusively on A_k/A_0 — the higher-jet conformal data. Conformal invariance at the horizon emerges as a consequence of the observability axioms, rather than an additional assumption.
